# workflowhooker

> Last-checked: 2026-08-04
> Verification: 82/82 Pytest-Tests 100% grün.

Canonical repository: https://github.com/ellmos-ai/workflowhooker-provenance
Owner: ellmos-ai (Ecosystem: open-bricks)
Primary language: Python (>=3.10)
License: MIT

WorkflowHooker (`ellmos-ai/workflowhooker-provenance`) ist ein Modul im `ellmos-ai`-Ökosystem für agentische Arbeitsablaufsteuerung, Pre-Tool-Checks, Drift-Warnungen und Abschluss-Gates.

## Kern-Dokumentation

- [README.md](README.md): Primary documentation (English), architecture, distinction from MemoryHooker, provider integration.
- [README_de.md](README_de.md): German documentation and architecture overview.
- [ROADMAP.md](ROADMAP.md): Development roadmap and phase planning.
- [ellmos-module.v2.json](ellmos-module.v2.json): Module manifest for the catalog (`orchestration`/`workflow`).
- [docs/reference/BACH-injectors.txt](docs/reference/BACH-injectors.txt): Reference of BACH injector patterns as blueprint.

## Disambiguation

WorkflowHooker governs **agent execution workflow and process integrity** (e.g. scope drift, verification prompts, closing gates). It is distinct from:
- `memoryhooker`: Injects persistent memory and domain knowledge into agent context.
- General CI/CD pipeline hook systems: WorkflowHooker is designed specifically for autonomous LLM agent runtimes (Claude Code, Codex CLI, Kimi Code).
